summary.en: An introduction and six complete essays on a book that printed its own critics: objections, replies and changing editions. Full optional SAE asides, edition notes and historical sources retained; independent German, French, Spanish, Japanese and Korean rewrites now join the original English and Chinese reading modes.
summary.zh: 小引与六篇正文，从反驳、答辩和不同版本读笛卡尔。新增德、法、西、日、韩完整独立重写，保留全部可选SAE旁注、版本校注与历史来源；原英简繁内容不变。
summary.zh-hant: 小引與六篇正文，從反駁、答辯和不同版本讀笛卡爾。新增德、法、西、日、韓完整獨立重寫，保留全部可選SAE旁注、版本校注與歷史來源；原英簡繁內容不變。
